title: Validation of the predictive value of circulating biomarkers in oncological patients under immunotherapy
summary:
1. Identifizierung von Patienten, die die Einschlusskriterien erfüllen
2. Einholung der Einwilligung
3. Blutentnahme
4. Analysen der Blutproben im Labor (entsprechend Abschnitt II, III, IV)
5. Verlaufskontrollen alle 3 Monate über 3 Jahre
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Patients/subjects > 18 years
- Treatment as part of palliative or adjuvant systemic therapy/immunotherapy
- Cancer patients who are treated outpatient or inpatient setting at the Department of Hematology, Oncology and Palliative Medicine at the UMR
- healthy, age- and gender-matched female subjects as a control group
Exclusion criteria:
- incapable of giving consent
- Failure to meet an inclusion criterion
